facts.fact: Senator Hassanein Tawfik's motion to the ICT ministry says Egypt lacks a unified e-commerce law, that the ministry's draft electronic transactions bill never emerged, and that lawmakers instead amended traditional trade laws, issued an e-signature law and taxed online trade.
